scope: Independent incremental font regression, exact winding, 0.25 UPM flattened proper crossings, fixed local grayscale ROIs and six-line symbol semantics.
scope_limits: Local grayscale white fractions are diagnostics, not universal readability acceptance.
No browser, Flutter, Android/iOS device, OS font scaling or professional hinting acceptance.
Strict proper crossings exclude endpoint touches and collinear overlap; flattening is numerical, not exact algebraic curve intersection.
Current-only portable checks cannot prove preservation or baseline-relative whitespace gains.

diagnostics.interpretation: Local curve/pixel quantization can differ by format and size. This measured exception is retained; not every ROI is claimed to improve. It is separate from vector counter expansion, geometry and readability acceptance.

hexagram_semantics.oracle: Independent published lower-row / upper-column matrix and received-order names; not generated from project JSON.

hexagram_row_separation.method: Actual native grayscale image row-alpha sum; count separated occupied bands above 25% of the strongest image row. No expected line centers are supplied to this measurement.
hexagram_row_separation.interpretation: Six detectable bands is a raster separation check, not subjective recognition or universal readability acceptance.

fixed_roi_method.measurement: Mean 1-alpha/255 over exactly the original source ROI, transformed x=.88*x+10, y unchanged; fractional pixel overlap weighting, identical baseline/origin, no resampling or ROI expansion.
fixed_roi_method.interpretation: Only local white-coverage change; not a claim that every internal slit is visually resolved or that the word is readable.
